title: Associated-point criterion for coherence of pushforward from an open subscheme
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof inducts simultaneously on associated points and generic-stalk length, extending local maps by multiplying by functions. The reverse direction constructs an injection from an integral support sheaf using its associated point. These two constructions reduce coherence of an arbitrary coherent sheaf to its associated integral components.
